title: Python for the host
summary: Python for the host: Python chosen; one language for the bot.
context: The host panel allowed Python or Node.
consequence: Python chosen; one language for the bot.

title: Chat-only control
summary: Chat-only control: All control is through Discord or Telegram.
consequence: All control is through Discord or Telegram.

title: Approval buttons
summary: Approval buttons: Four buttons: Once, Session, Always (exact), Deny.
context: Risky code needs a human check.
consequence: Four buttons: Once, Session, Always (exact), Deny.

title: Always Allow is exact text
summary: Always Allow is exact text: Only identical commands match.

title: Subprocess sandbox, not a container
summary: Subprocess sandbox, not a container: Limited subprocess plus an optional external sandbox.
context: The free host gives no container runtime.
consequence: Limited subprocess plus an optional external sandbox.

title: Core code is hard blocked
summary: Core code is hard blocked: No button exists for protected paths.
context: The agent could edit its own safeguards.
consequence: No button exists for protected paths.

title: Allow-list fails closed
summary: Allow-list fails closed: Everyone is refused until a list is set.
context: An empty list should not mean open.
consequence: Everyone is refused until a list is set.

title: One process
summary: One process: Bot, scheduler and workers share one process.
consequence: Bot, scheduler and workers share one process.

title: Rename to Kaizen Manas
summary: Rename to Kaizen Manas: Display rename on 2026-09-17. Repo name unchanged.
context: Kaizen is steady improvement. Manas is Sanskrit for mind.
consequence: Display rename on 2026-09-17. Repo name unchanged.

title: Time-boxed /allow
summary: Time-boxed /allow: A window of 5, 10 or 30 minutes.
context: Always Allow is too permanent for busy sessions.

title: Tool groups
summary: Tool groups: Groups can be switched off.
context: A long tool list costs tokens.

title: Tiers customised by commands only
summary: Tiers customised by commands only: Only commands write the routing file.
context: The agent should not change its own routing.
consequence: Only commands write the routing file.

title: Supervisor with rollback
summary: Supervisor with rollback: deploy_watch.py rolls back on early exit.
context: A bad commit should not take the bot down.
consequence: deploy_watch.py rolls back on early exit.

title: Shell off by default
summary: Shell off by default: Operator-only switch.
